description.value:
Patterned off classic Nomad designs, the Modular 6-Shot is a common sight among security details on MetaKey. It’s small, accurate, reliable, and unlikely to accidentally hit VIPs by overpenetrating targets. It’s also rather customizable, with many MKPD Officers outfitting it with tear gas launchers or stun bayonets.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

Class: EQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Zenith • Mods: Compatibility Rework

Special Features: The first Turn in combat this weapon makes a Single Shot Attack, the user gains a +1 bonus to their Attack Check [Zenith]. This weapon can equip Underbarrel and Bayonet Attachments [Compatibility Rework]. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Zenith (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Compatibility Rework

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
